answer_1.quote: The purpose of this study is to explore how to leverage PLMs, specifically RoBERTa (an encoder model) and GPT-4 (a decoder model), for ASC annotations which could assist in modeling and measuring human language development.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are ASC (Argument Structure Construction) tags assigned to clauses, such as CAUS_MOT, DITRAN, INTRAN_MOT, etc., representing different clausal-level constructions.
